title: AudioTQ: A Data-Oblivious 6-Bit CPU Audio Codec via Randomized Hadamard Rotation and Lloyd-Max Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2608.15369v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Lossy audio compression algorithms traditionally rely on psychoacoustic modeling and frequency-domain representations (e.g., MP3, AAC, and Opus) to discard information that is imperceptible to the human auditory system. While highly effective, these approaches are computationally complex and domain-specific. In this paper, we present the design and mathematical formulation of AudioTQ, a data-oblivious lossy audio codec that operates directly in the time domain. Inspired by Large Language Model (LLM) weight quantization techniques (specifically the TurboQuant framework), AudioTQ uniformizes volatile time-domain amplitudes into a predictable standard normal distribution using an orthonormal, randomized Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform (FWHT) rotation. This enables coordinate-wise scalar quantization using an offline-trained, MSE-optimal 6-bit Lloyd-Max quantizer, augmented by a 1-bit Quantized Joint Least-Squares (QJL) residual correction l

translated_title: AudioTQ：一种通过随机哈达玛旋转和Lloyd-Max量化实现的数据无关6位CPU音频编解码器
translated_abstract: 传统有损音频压缩算法通常依赖心理声学建模和频域表示（如MP3、AAC和Opus）来丢弃人耳听觉系统无法感知的信息。虽然这些方法非常有效，但计算复杂度高且具有领域特定性。在本文中，我们提出了AudioTQ的设计和数学公式，这是一种数据无关的有损音频编解码器，直接在时域中操作。受大语言模型（LLM）权重量化技术（特别是TurboQuant框架）的启发，AudioTQ使用正交、随机的快速沃尔什-哈达玛变换（FWHT）旋转，将波动的时间域幅度均匀化为可预测的标准正态分布。这使得可以使用离线训练的、均方误差最优的6位Lloyd-Max量化器进行逐坐标标量量化，并辅以1位量化联合最小二乘（QJL）残差校正。
tldr: AudioTQ通过随机哈达玛旋转将音频时域信号转化为标准正态分布，结合6位Lloyd-Max量化与1位残差校正，实现了一种数据无关、计算高效的时域有损音频压缩方法。
en_tdlr: AudioTQ converts time-domain audio signals into a standard normal distribution via randomized Hadamard rotation, combined with 6-bit Lloyd-Max quantization and 1-bit residual correction, achieving a data-oblivious and computationally efficient lossy audio compression method.
